messages:
emma_sales: Quick one — customer (EU-finreg) wants an evaluation across EU + APAC with strict data residency. Asking: can we guarantee no-eu-egress for hosted POC? also need list of sub-processors and an estimate of incremental cost for regional pinning.
raj_soleng: Short answer: yes we can do EU-only for request/response paths if we pin to eu region or use Dedicated in EU. Hosted has fallbacks we need to configure to avoid global fallthrough. :thinking:
marta_infra: Sub-processors: we have GCP-europe (subproc-id:gcp-eu-3), AWS-eu (subproc-id:aws-eu-1), FastEdge-APAC for caching but we can disable APAC edge for strict residency. Inventory link: https://internal.redwood/subprocs (internal).
lina_legal: Need to confirm DPA + SCCs for region scoping. If customer requires zero egress to non-EU, we must disable cross-region failover in the routing policy and sign the addendum. Also will need an audit log export cadence (monthly?) for them.
tom_arch: Routing config snippet we typically propose for strict residency (example):
```
routing_policy:
  mode: region_pin
  region: eu-west-1
  fallthrough: none
  subprocessor_filter: [gcp-eu-3, aws-eu-1]
```
Note: hosted will still call some infra services for metrics; we'll document those endpoints.
emma_sales: Customer asks pricing impact — ballpark numbers so they can budget? POC expected 3 weeks, low volume.
marta_infra: Ballpark: hosted with regional pin + increased SLA = approx +15% on top of standard hosted rates. Dedicated (small reserved) for POC is roughly 3x monthly cost vs pay-as-you-go hosted at low volumes but gives you absolute residency guarantees. Private (on-prem/VPC) is quoted separately. I'll add rough ranges in a follow-up.
raj_soleng: For POC ops: we need customer's allowed IP ranges for egress allowlist (if they want strict network controls), signed DPA, and confirmation they accept no cross-region fallback. We can spin up a pinned host in eu-west-1 in ~48 hours once approvals + billing are sorted.
emma_sales: Customer also asked about subprocessor certs (ISO / SOC). Can we provide cert list per subproc?
marta_infra: Yes — GCP and AWS certs available (ISO27001, SOC2). I'll attach cert list in the internal ticket. ingress-bot: New region-pin request created: PIN-1932 (assigned to @marta_infra).
lina_legal: Also flag: if they require APAC as well but physically segregated, we'll need separate pinned deployments per region and separate dataflows — doubles the operational footprint.
emma_sales: Great — next steps: i) send DPA + list of subproc certs ii) confirm whether customer wants APAC separate deployment iii) provide budget ranges. I'll draft an email. @raj_soleng can you confirm 48h spin-up and whether we can offer a limited trial discount for POC?
raj_soleng: Confirm 48h for hosted pin once DPA + billing done. We can offer a one-time POC credit to offset first 2 weeks (sales approval required).
emma_sales: Thanks team — I'll follow up with the customer and attach this thread. :thumbsup:
